# Code of conduct

Be kind, be specific, assume good faith. Disagree about code, not about people. No harassment of any kind.
Maintainers may remove, edit or reject contributions and comments that do not follow this, and may ban repeat
offenders. Report problems by opening an issue, or through the repository's private reporting form if it is sensitive.

This is a short form of the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).
